Specify the memory budget for decoded media cached by `<Video>` and `<Audio>` from `@remotion/media`, in bytes. This value also determines the maximum read cache size for each distinct media source. It is not a limit on total memory usage. <br />The default is half of the available system memory when the render starts.

## CLI flag

Use `--media-cache-size-in-bytes` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                   | `--media-cache-size-in-bytes <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--media-cache-size-in-bytes <value>` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                     | `--media-cache-size-in-bytes <value>` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)       | `--media-cache-size-in-bytes <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--media-cache-size-in-bytes <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--media-cache-size-in-bytes <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)       | `--media-cache-size-in-bytes <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--media-cache-size-in-bytes <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)   | `--media-cache-size-in-bytes <value>` |
